diagnostic.purpose: Split R on the river map by shaded area and per-pixel texture/shading/filter cost. No handset FPS claim.
diagnostic.map: old sym9 village/river map from immutable Perspective/Tex3 parent: maps/kordos/kordos.3d, baked lightmap/kordod.vla, Tex3 slots forest/map-selo1/river
diagnostic.renderer: fork of immutable StaticRoomPerspectiveMesh/Stats; same GRID selector, face order, buffers, calls and stage timers
diagnostic.default: S100 TEX SM B (full viewport, atlas textures, smooth shading, base-level filtering)

controls.key1: BASE reset: S100 + TEX + SMOOTH + BASE_LEVEL
controls.key0: cycle render scale 100 -> 75 -> 50 -> 25 percent (other toggles preserved)
controls.key7: toggle atlas textures <-> 1x1 white texture modulated by baked vertex colors (alpha threshold forced 0 in 1X1; diagnostic image intentionally grayscale/solid)
controls.star: toggle texture level filter BASE_LEVEL <-> NEAREST (nearest mip level; image filter remains NEAREST)
controls.movement: 2/8 move, 4/6 turn; no strafe because 7/9 are pixel toggles

diagnostic.render_scale: native M3G Image/viewport itself is scaled with proportional focals and drawn 1:1 at top-left; uncovered Canvas bars are filled black outside native render timing
diagnostic.hud: always two live lines: mode/FPS and N/R/I; no full diagnostic panel in measured frames
diagnostic.m3g_compatibility: Target user-reported Nokia E65 M3G 1.0: only basic Texture2D filtering and PolygonMode shading switches already present in JSR-184; mip level filter is a hint and may be ignored by the implementation
diagnostic.alpha: original thresholds in TEX modes; diagnostic 1X1 mode intentionally uses threshold 0
diagnostic.depth: test/write ON except river write OFF, as parent
diagnostic.perspective: ON fixed (previous handset result: OFF almost no effect)
diagnostic.river: all 4 cached frames, speed6, mode7; in 1X1 mode the same geometry/pass samples the white texel instead
diagnostic.pump: same worker repaint()+serviceRepaints()+sleep(1) in all modes
diagnostic.stats_note: R is the Graphics3D.render loop inside N; Java API wall time, NOT GPU timestamps or proven LCD flips

purpose: Isolated river-map pixel-cost A/B: render scale, atlas vs 1x1 texture, smooth/flat shading, and base vs nearest-mip filtering.
